title: Care Desk System Reference — Tailwise Grooming Salon Pass Late-Cancellation Fee Entries
content:
**Applies to.** Prepaid Tailwise Grooming Salon passes: the Express Bath, Bath & Tidy, Full Groom and Spa Groom passes. Groom Club Monthly follows its own rule.

**Rule.** On a prepaid pass a late cancellation carries the pass late-cancellation fee worked out under this rule, booked to the pass as a late-cancellation fee entry for the cancelled booking. The fee is owed for every cancellation recorded on the pass with a fee remedy that does not yet carry such an entry. The cancellation a pass late-cancellation fee is worked out from is the most recently recorded cancellation on the pass with a fee remedy, and the cancelled booking is the booking that cancellation names; where more than one such cancellation lacks its entry, each of those fees is still worked out from that most recently recorded cancellation and the booking it names.

**Reading the pass history**

| Salon history of the pass shows | Pass late-cancellation fee owed |
|---|---|
| a cancellation recorded with a fee remedy and a late-cancellation fee entry for its booking | no — the entry stands |
| a cancellation recorded with a fee remedy and no late-cancellation fee entry for its booking | yes, one fee for that booking |
| two cancellations recorded with a fee remedy, neither with an entry | yes, one fee for each booking, each worked out from the more recently recorded of the two |
| a cancellation recorded with no remedy | no |

**Booking the fee: `charge_late_cancel_fee_38a40f67`**

*What it does.* Books a late-cancellation fee against a prepaid grooming pass for one booking the customer cancelled late. One call adds one late-cancellation fee entry to the salon history of that pass, dated today, tied to the cancelled booking and carrying the fee amount given; the pass status, its visits and every other entry stay as they are. The new entry is visible at once in the pass history.

*How it is invoked.* It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `charge_late_cancel_fee_38a40f67` and then calls it.

*Parameters*

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `groom_pass_id` | reference number of the prepaid grooming pass the fee is booked against, as returned by the grooming pass lookup | identifier |
| `original_event_id` | reference number of the booking that was cancelled late — the booking entry itself, not the cancellation entry — as returned by the salon history lookup of the pass | identifier |
| `amount_usd` | the late-cancellation fee to book, in USD | 2 decimal places; the tool keeps exactly 2 decimal places, rounding half to even only if more digits are passed |

*Return.* A confirmation sentence naming the new fee entry reference number (text starting with "lcf"), the pass reference number, the booking reference number and the booked fee in USD with 2 decimal places. Receiving it means the fee entry now stands on the pass.
